summary: Join our Community-Based Disaster Risk Management Training Course to gain essential skills in disaster preparedness and community resilience. Enroll today!
lede: Community-based disaster risk management (CBDRM) helps disaster preparedness and resilience professionals organize locally led risk reduction before emergencies. The course builds practical skills in participatory risk profiling and hazard mapping, designing community warning and preparedness plans, and testing and improving them through drills and reviews.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals engaged in disaster preparedness, response, and resilience programming across various sectors.
audience: Disaster risk management officers and coordinators
Community mobilizers, social development officers, and field
modules: CBDRM Foundations and Why Community Ownership Matters
Participatory Risk Profiling and Community Engagement Skills
Hazard Mapping and Vulnerability Assessment Tools
Early Warning Systems and Risk Communication at Community Level
Community Preparedness Planning and Contingency Design
Linking CBDRM to Livelihoods, Climate Adaptation, and Development
Coordination with Government Systems and Humanitarian Architecture
Monitoring, Learning, and Accountability in CBDRM Programs
Risk Financing and Resource Mobilization for Community Preparedness
Capstone: Build and Defend a Community CBDRM Plan
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of disaster risk management principles and experience working with community-based projects. Familiarity with local governance and development programming is beneficial.
